4 P_ACTIVE →P_RESTARTING
An event has occurred that initiates the restart of the partition:
• The OS receives PRO_TERMINATEAPPL_RESTART from a call to the Protection Hook.
• A call to TerminateApplication() is made with the parameter set to RESTART. The OS triggers the OSRestartTask. In that task, all actions necessary for terminating the partition are initiated. Note: The OS cannot distinguish between this transition and the transition P_ACTIVE →P_TERMINATING. This distinction needs to be communicated to the OSRestartTask by other means.
